segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 38-seat plan for the service team and make sure the March 18 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It does. We have 32 reps and 6 supervisors. The only thing I want to confirm is billing. We need the invoice to hit after April 1 because that's our new fiscal quarter.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's in the order form: service starts March 18, first invoice dated April 2, net 30. Annual total is $27,360 before tax, and implementation is the one-time $4,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation includes the two admin trainings, right? We have Alicia and Mark as the admins.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two 90-minute admin sessions, one rep enablement session for the full group, and the data import for your existing cases. I have Alicia and Mark listed for admin training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Legal had one question on the renewal language. They don't want auto-renewal longer than one year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's already set to 12-month renewal terms with 30 days' notice before the renewal date. No multi-year auto-renewal. I sent the redline back this morning.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If we add seats mid-year, is that prorated or do we true up at renewal?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Prorated from the activation date through March 17 next year. Same per-seat rate, $60 per user per month, and it just gets added to the next monthly invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send me the final order form and I'll route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have it in your inbox in about ten minutes, and once it's signed, our onboarding coordinator will send the kickoff calendar invite for next Tuesday at 11 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If we can keep that kickoff to 45 minutes, I'll have the supervisors join too.
